mentions.name: Trivyn
mentions.description: Ontology-first knowledge platform that runs on a single machine via a single executable. The backend is written in Rust and uses oxigraph for its triple store. A free version is planned for academic/personal use, with a private beta targeted for release by Christmas.
mentions.audience: Simpler alternative to large, complicated enterprise knowledge products that dominate the space.
mentions.source_excerpt: Trivyn: Ontology-first knowledge platform.  Runs on a single machine, via a single executable.  I wanted a simpler alternative to the large complicated enterprise products that tend to dominate this space.
